operations.title: Texture progenitor conjecture: if the pi/8 chart-space clustering is not a scan artifact, it is the fingerprint of an unnamed selection rule on the nine-link texture ensemble — typed operationally as a weight/selection functional on F_9^sparse whose pushforward through the viability map sigma lands on the observed flavor point; observables are pushforward expectations, and the clustering constrains the measure's support, not the physical invariant ring. Structural fingerprint any candidate generator must reproduce: sparsity (9 links), cycle rank b1=1 (single holonomy), CP phase avoiding all determinant perfect matchings in most viable textures. Evidence is middle-layer only (charts certified, sigma full-rank with discrete fibers); the generator layer is unconstrained by anything computed so far. Emergence direction: UV dynamics -> texture ensemble selection -> physical flavor point (inverted Marici pattern: charts as readout of a sector-specific hidden generator, not realization of a shared parent).
